programme.desc: The second round of heats sees eight new robots join the fight for The Seventh Wars title. Growler is de-muzzled as he rampages through the arena in the four-way melees, no-one is safe.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: After the four-way melees, the house robots do not hesitate to get involved with the remaining competitors. A counter-attack leads to one of the shortest finals robot wars has ever seen.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: An equal number of newcomers and veterans take to the battlefield in this episode, experience versus vigor in today’s heats. The innocent Refbot gets attacked after cease is called.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The Sixth Wars champions return to the arena to battle for the Seventh Wars title. Do they still have what it takes to win, or will the competition be too fierce this time round?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: A newcomer from Germany joins the UK competitors in this week’s heats. Will they put show the UK how it’s done, or will the other robots have a home advantage?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Another German joins the roster this week. One robot becomes an eviction technician, removing their opponents from the arena. Refbot joins the fray as he helps pit an immobilised robot.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: A robot representing the Netherlands fights with the Brits in this heat. After attempting to attack one of the house robots, Growler makes an example of one of the competitors. Matilda uses her flywheel in spectacular fashion.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: One hapless robot gets expertly dismantled by another competitor, leaving Refbot to count them out. Maybe the house robots should take notes. A Hail Mary charge leaves yet another robot out of the arena.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The Seventh Wars continues, eight more robots with high hopes of becoming champion enter the arena. One robot has to see a man about a dog, as Mr. Psycho and Growler team up on a competitor.

programme.title: Improbably Poppy
programme.desc: Poppy starts to worry her whims might have consequences and brings in a scientist and a theologist to unpack chaos theory, the butterfly effect, and free will—while she processes the futility of it all. A game-show parody (“Lucky Case Game”) goes off the rails, the house band Rodent’s Revenge keeps the chaos moving, and Poppy “liberates” her beloved plants with the gift of free will. TV-14. Fictional violence and language.

programme.title: Gottmik / Mayer Hawthorne: Side Hustles
programme.desc: Gottmik launches a beauty brand, while Mayer Hawthorne shares his wine and vinyl-inspired business journey.

programme.title: Gogol Bordello: Live From Union Transfer in Philadelphia
programme.desc: Gogol Bordello bring their post-punk energy to Philly’s Union Transfer. Their explosive global punky party is on full display.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: GRAMMY-winning singer-songwriter Brandon Lake joins Joel Madden to talk balancing fame and family, using music to share his relationship with faith, and previewing his upcoming album King of Hearts. He opens up about hiring a performance/health coach for life on tour, dialing in nutrition and strength training, life on a new South Carolina farm, growing up in church and learning guitar, and the joy of community in music—from a viral onstage “Higher” moment to swapping stories about Creed and meeting Scott Stapp.

programme.title: Lost Evenings VI: Night 4 – Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Frank Turner & The Sleeping Souls close out Lost Evenings VI in Anaheim with a sold-out, career-spanning set packed with fan favorites, sing-alongs and candid moments. Highlights include “1933,” “Recovery,” “The Next Storm,” “Miranda” and “Little Changes,” capping four nights of music and celebration.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Carly Pearce on Artist Friendly. Pearce reflects on leaving high school at 16 for Dollywood, moving to Nashville at 19, and years of grinding before her breakthrough. She opens up about trusting her instincts, turning heartbreak into Grammy-winning music, and making peace with the hardest chapters of her story.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Bobby from the British punk-rap duo Bob Vylan joins Joel Madden for an unfiltered conversation about self-determination, identity, and breaking barriers in music. Bobby opens up about growing up between London and Ipswich, navigating racism, finding purpose through education, and how his lived experiences fuel the band’s powerful, socially charged sound.

programme.title: Hey Violet: The Final Show (Live from Los Angeles)
programme.desc: Recorded live in Los Angeles, this farewell concert captures Hey Violet’s final performance together after nine years as a band. Featuring raw emotion, high energy, and fan-favorite songs, the show is a powerful celebration of their evolution from pop-punk newcomers to alternative mainstays.

programme.title: Kings of Leon: Live at The O2 London, England
programme.desc: Kings of Leon performs live at The O2 in London, delivering hits like Sex on Fire and Use Somebody in a high-energy set.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: On this week's episode of Artist Friendly, Joel Madden sits down with Paul Walter Hauser. From waiting tables to a Golden Globe, Emmy, and Critics' Choice Award for Black Bird — Paul Walter Hauser has built one of Hollywood's most distinctive careers by refusing to play it safe. Now starring in Fantastic Four and the new Resident Evil, he gets honest about fear, learning to say no, and why being his realest self matters more than chasing the next big role.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Sam Carter, the powerhouse vocalist of Architects, for a candid conversation about gut instincts, creative integrity, and nearly two decades of building one of heavy music’s most influential bands. Sam opens up about his serendipitous bond with Good Charlotte, the “say yes or say no” mindset that guides his decisions, and how gratitude—and a little British self-deprecation—keep him grounded. He reflects on Warped Tour dreams turned stadium reality, the band’s tight-knit dynamic, and why this era is about smiling more, having fun, and bringing the wide-eyed 13-year-old version of himself back on stage. They also talk about Architects’ new album, The Sky, The Earth & All Between (out Feb 28), aiming to make their 11th record their biggest and most honest yet.

programme.title: Queen: Live at the Rainbow '74
programme.desc: Queen performs a 1974 concert at London’s Rainbow Theatre, capturing the band’s early rise with a powerful live set.

programme.title: Elevation Worship and Steven Furtick: Elevation Nights Live from Philadelphia
programme.desc: Elevation Worship and Steven Furtick perform the final stop of Elevation Nights 2024 in Philadelphia with a powerful live worship experience.

programme.title: Reggie Watts: Never Mind
programme.desc: Comedian, musician, and improvisational mastermind Reggie Watts takes the stage in Los Angeles for a performance that bends space, sound, and sense itself. Blending stand-up, music, and live looping, Never Mind explores technology, nostalgia, and the absurdity of modern life through spontaneous humor and sonic experimentation. Both futuristic and deeply human, this live special showcases Watts’ singular ability to find rhythm and meaning in chaos.

programme.title: Megadeth - Crush The World Tour Live from Buenos Aires – Night 2
programme.desc: Night two of the Megadeth two-night stand at Buenos Aires’ Movistar Arena on the Crush The World Tour. Filmed for Veeps, Night 2 delivers a blistering set of thrash classics and newer tracks, led by Dave Mustaine and fueled by the crowd’s relentless energy.

programme.title: Improbably Poppy
programme.desc: In this surreal premiere, Poppy hits the streets of Monrovia offering eerie fortunes, interviews a survivor of the Dave Matthews Band bus disaster, and encounters Archduke Franz Ferdinand in a time-warping twist. Between absurd sketches and existential reflections, she performs a musical lesson on embracing chaos and taking risks. TV-14 (fictional violence, language).

programme.title: Improbably Poppy
programme.desc: Poppy guides the puppets through a disturbingly enlightening lesson on “growing up,” from receding hairlines and miracle fixes to a viewer “gift” of unwanted pizzas that spirals into paranoia. A long-lost educational reel on second puberty resurfaces before Poppy and Joel crunch “life-or-death” fractions and Poppy closes with a bleak lullaby about adulthood. TV-14.

programme.title: The Way Home [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Seven-year-old Sang Woo is left with his grandmother in a remote village while his mother looks for work. Born and raised in the city, Sang Woo quickly comes into conflict with his old-fashioned grandmother and his new rural surroundings. Disrespectful and selfish, Sang Woo lashes out in anger, perceiving that he has been abandoned. He trades his grandmother's only treasure for a video game; he throws his food and he throws tantrums. When Sang Woo's mother finds work and finally returns for him, Sang Woo has become a different boy. Through his grandmother's boundless patience and devotion, he learns to embrace empathy, humility, and the importance of family.

programme.title: 200 Pounds Beauty [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Han-na is a large girl with a warm heart, who also has an unbelievable voice. She wants to become a pop-singer, but because she is unattractive, she’s only given opportunities to ghost-sing for a popular singer named Amy. Han-na is also in love with Amy’s producer, Sang-joon, but Sang-joon doesn’t notice her. One day, Han-Na is invited to Sang-Joon’s birthday party and receives a red dress from him to wear to his party. programme.title: My Daughter is a Zombie [English Dub]
programme.desc: Lee Jeong-hwan, a fierce animal trainer, lives a chaotic daily life with his rebellious teenage daughter, Lee Su-a who is full of passion for dancing. One day, Su-a becomes infected by a zombie virus that has swept across the globe. In a desperate bid to protect her, Jeong-hwan takes Su-a to Eunbong-ri, a seaside village where his mother, Kim Bam-sun, lives. Amid growing societal pressure to root out the infected, Jeong-hwan notices that Su-a, despite being a zombie, vaguely understands human speech and reacts to her favorite things: dancing and her grandmother’s sharp but loving flicks of the hand. Refusing to give up on her, Jeong-hwan draws on his years of experience as a tiger trainer and begins an intensive training program for his zombie daughter. A training journey more terrifying than handling a tiger and more difficult than dealing with teenage angst begins. The most heartwarming and hilarious top-secret project is about to unfold!

programme.desc: Let any burdens you carry drop away while you move through this gentle, intentional qigong practice.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: As humans, we need interconnection: We rely on others to survive, especially as children. Yet, we also strive for authenticity. This creates an inherent tension. In this lesson, Dr. Maté discusses what is true human nature — and how the modern world has warped our understanding of our needs.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: Trauma is a wound that you sustain; it's not what happened to you. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains why traumatic wounds get triggered and how to understand triggers in your process of transformation and healing.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: There is a strong link between childhood trauma and health challenges. Dr. Maté demonstrates how to untangle and understand this connection with self-compassion.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness

programme.title: Road To Dharma

programme.title: Road To Dharma
programme.desc: Jen and Jeff’s dream is to save their marriage on this journey, but it’s clear they are in different mindsets from the beginning. We are reminded that Anand himself had a prophecy of death and his teachers and life adventures helped guide him to freedom. Heading towards Kedarnath, night’s darkness sets in and Ryan sees someone Flip over their handlebars…

programme.title: Road To Dharma
programme.desc: Our first glimpse of the first peak, Kedarnath, the temple of death. Anand reminds us that What needs to die is part of the ego, fears, and comforts. Ken thinks people are riding recklessly, Mario takes his first spill, injuring his passenger Aizhan. Jeff ‘s comments further alienate Jen, but motivate her to rise up to greatness…

programme.title: Road To Dharma
programme.desc: Emptiness and Power in the Gap. The stunning Tungnath Peak at 13,000 ft, the Feminine Temple above the Masculine. Ken goes from rational doubter to having an experience beyond understanding that relates to his deceased sister. Unfortunately, the experience is tainted by ignorance and the seemingly inspiring day is further marred when Anna has an accident…

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Grief is the death of something—someone, a relationship, a job, or a dream. There’s no timeline, and you cannot heal what you do not feel. Guided by David Kessler, this course helps you navigate your river of grief, honor your unique process, and find a path toward healing.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Grief is about the heart, but the mind shapes the story we tell. While you can’t change the facts of loss, you can change the narrative, honor old wounds, and choose words that guide you toward growth, meaning, and deeper connection to joy and healing.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.desc: Loss can make you feel powerless, but grief is your work and your power. David Kessler guides you to grieve fully on your terms, honor your unique process, and reclaim agency over your healing, showing that you can live fully while holding your pain with strength.

programme.desc: Agustín decide darle el divorcio a Magdalena, y la tenencia de Rodrigo, pero a cambio de eso quiere quedarse con la galería de arte. Nayarí se encuentra preparando los carnavales. Antonio consiguió trabajo junto a Agustín, en la galería de arte. programme.title: Toda Mujer

Por otro lado, María del Pilar asegura que su hijo es de Marcelo ante la presión de Gustavo. Mientras Marcelo busca el divorcio de Graciela, Misael continúa profesando su amor por Manuela en medio de tensiones familiares y planes de venganza.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo regresa a la casa Tariffi, rompe con Katiuska y reafirma su amor por Manuela. Mientras Katiuska conspira contra los hijos de Ricardo y busca ayuda de criminales, Gustavo es hospitalizado por su grave estado de intoxicación. Marcelo es engañado por María del Pilar sobre un falso embarazo y Elizabeth oculta síntomas de una enfermedad. Finalmente, Ricardo lee una emotiva carta de Celia que lo insta a cuidar de sus hijos y a unirse definitivamente con Manuela.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo lee una carta de Celia pidiéndole casarse con Manuela y cuidar a sus hijos. Katiuska contrata a Renato para eliminar a Manuela. Se descubre que el testamento de la Nona es válido y que Katiuska robó el original, quedando fuera de la herencia junto a Hortensia. Elizabeth asiste al médico y se confirma que su salud no es grave. Finalmente, Ricardo ve un video que prueba la traición de Katiuska y la expulsa de su casa, mientras María del Pilar confiesa que no está embarazada.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El 13 de marzo de 2015, en Villa Lozada, La Plata, Huila, cuatro miembros de la familia Ramírez fueron brutalmente asesinados. Aunque inicialmente se sospechó un atraco, la investigación reveló que el crimen fue obra de una banda dedicada al apoderamiento ilegal de terrenos en Ciudad Bolívar, quienes buscaban el millonario botín que la familia guardaba, producto de su negocio de comercialización de café.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2010, en Putumayo, Myriam Zamora fue acusada de asesinar a sus dos pequeños hijos e intentar suicidarse. Aunque ella se declaró víctima y refutó las acusaciones de la Fiscalía y de su esposo durante el proceso, no logró presentar pruebas que respaldaran su versión. Sin evidencia que sustentara su inocencia, fue condenada y pasará varios años tras las rejas.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El 17 octubre del 2015, en el corregimiento de Belén, en El Banco Magdalena, dos hombres abusaron y asesinaron a Valeria Peña, una menor de 15 años que logró sobrevivir antes los ataques y dejar un testimonio donde señalaba a José Fernando López como el autor material de su crimen. Sin embargo, un tercer testimonio involucro al hermano de José Fernando y el autor intelectual quien tenía claras intenciones de venganza.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2007, María Cecilia Viva Salas desapareció en Buenaventura, generando conmoción en su barrio. Inicialmente se sospechó de pandilleros, pero la investigación reveló que su esposo Harvey era el responsable. Su hija Pilar, testigo silenciada por miedo, finalmente reveló pistas clave. El rastreo del celular llevó a su cuerpo, hallado en su propia casa. Harvey confesó y fue condenado a 18 años, aunque salió libre tras cumplir la mitad de la pena.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Deibis Mildred y Adolfo González formaron una familia y un negocio exitoso de confecciones en Riohacha. En 2008, Adolfo fue asesinado en su casa, un crimen inicialmente sin resolver. Tres años después, las sospechas recayeron sobre Deibis Mildred, señalada de planear el homicidio junto a un amante para cobrar un seguro de vida. Fue condenada a 40 años de cárcel como coautora del asesinato.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2008, Nidia Yazmín González, madre soltera de 37 años, fue hallada muerta en el río Gámeza, Boyacá, con signos de brutal violencia. Mantenía una relación secreta con Alirio Castro, un hombre casado, posesivo y celoso. Pruebas clave —su cinturón negro en karate y un historial de maltrato— lo señalaron como responsable. Absuelto en 2009, la fiscalía apeló y en 2011 fue condenado a 33 años de prisión.

programme.title: Las tres reinas
programme.desc: Las tres reinas: así es como Mikhail Pogodin, director y propietario de una bodega en la ciudad de Chernomorsk, quería nombrar la marca de su nuevo vino, pero no llegó a hacerlo... Fue encontrado muerto en su piso. Viktor, su hijo, regresa a su ciudad natal y decide investigar la causa de la muerte de su padre y salvar el negocio familiar.

programme.title: Las tres reinas
programme.desc: Víctor descubre que su padre trabajaba en un vino especial. Mientras tanto, su madrastra Ella es manipulada por su amante para entregar documentos de la bodega. Todo parece indicar un suicidio, pero Víctor no está convencido.

programme.title: Las tres reinas
programme.desc: Un experto revela que la nota de despedida de Pogodin es falsa. Víctor busca a un anciano en las montañas para descubrir el secreto del vino "Tres Reinas". Mientras tanto, el vicealcalde ordena vigilarlo de cerca.

programme.title: Las tres reinas
programme.desc: Ella intenta sobornar a Víctor para que abandone la investigación. Katya consigue los diarios del padre de Víctor. La prometida de Víctor, Zhenya, llega a la ciudad, pero él se da cuenta de que siempre ha amado a Katya.

programme.title: Las tres reinas
programme.desc: Zhenya promete ayudar a Víctor, pero lo aleja de la ciudad. Mientras tanto, Ella descubre que ha sido utilizada por su amante. Oleg busca probar la autenticidad del testamento de Pogodin. Víctor escapa y regresa.

programme.title: Las tres reinas
programme.desc: Zhenya se alía con Sergey para separar a Katya de Víctor. El detective Litvinov regresa. Sergey droga a Katya y toma fotos comprometedoras. Su padre denuncia su desaparición a la policía.

programme.title: Las tres reinas
programme.desc: Víctor ve las fotos y cree que Katya lo traicionó. Ella, en crisis, intenta suicidarse, pero Víctor la salva. Katya logra escapar de Sergey, pero es arrestada tras una orden del vicealcalde.

programme.title: Las tres reinas
programme.desc: Víctor y Oleg encuentran pruebas contra Sergey. Víctor rompe con Zhenya y busca a Katya en prisión. Litvinov es atacado y queda gravemente herido. Ella confiesa que fue la última en ver a Pogodin con vida.
